questions.question: A utility that locates and opens files in CentOS 7 is _____. Choices: Windows Explorer; File Search; Control Center; Files; Search.
A utility that locates and opens files in Windows 10 is _____. Choices: Control Center; the Search box; File Browser; Windows File Explorer.

If you cannot move the taskbar, _____. Choices: double-click it; unlock it by right-clicking an empty area of the taskbar and clicking Lock the taskbar to clear the check mark; unlock it by right-clicking an empty area of the taskbar and clicking Unlock the taskbar; do not worry; the taskbar cannot be moved.
In CentOS 7, the taskbar is commonly referred to as a _____. Choices: menu; taskbar; file; Top Bar.

Menus are customized to _____. Select all that apply. Choices: change fonts, color schemes, and window behaviors; remove unused data; group applications by use; provide shortcuts to frequently used applications.
The Windows 10 default Start menu is divided into _____ part(s). Choices: 4; 1; 3; 2.
To add an application as a tile to the Windows Start menu, click _____. Choices: Pin to Taskbar; Add to Start; Add to Taskbar; Pin to Start.
To filter a search in File Explorer in Windows 10, you can use the _____ option. Select all that apply. Choices: directory; Date deleted; Size; Date modified.
To start applications in CentOS 7, use the _____. Choices: Start Menu; Applications Menu; Launch menu; Configure menu.
To start applications in Windows 10, use the _____. Choices: Launch menu; Control Center; Start menu; Applications menu.
What is the default GUI application in CentOS 7? Choices: KVM; GNOME; Lollypop; Windows.
What is the default number of workspaces in CentOS 7? Choices: 3; 1; 4; 6.
When you delete files from a folder, where do they go? Select all that apply. Choices: Trash; the Delete Folder; File Manager; Recycle Bin.

Which of the following actions permits more information to appear on the screen? Select all that apply. Choices: increasing the screen resolution; decreasing the size of text; decreasing the screen resolution; increasing the size of text.
Which of the following items are commonly found on the Windows 10 taskbar? Select all that apply. Choices: Clock; File menu; Start button; open applications.
Which of the following options appear on the Windows 10 Start menu by default? Select all that apply. Choices: Music; Power; trash; settings.
Windows 10 desktop features include _____. Select all that apply. Choices: Jump lists; Snap; Peek; Shake.
You can tailor the desktop to provide _____. Select all that apply. Choices: shortcuts to frequently used applications; privacy; quick access to running applications; an organized workspace.

You can use the taskbar to _____. Select all that apply. Choices: modify the current taskbar settings; quickly move between open applications; change the configuration of the Start menu; monitor current tasks.
As an aid to organization in Windows 10 or CentOS 7, files are grouped by _____. Choices: libraries; folders; places; partitions.
